| 2026-09-10 | 5.248.0 | 🔬 BTD6 Memory Trainer Root-Cause Remediation: Natural Memory Alignment Filter, Chunk Boundary Overlap, Multi-Stage Next-Scan Pipeline & HUD Scanner Calibration | **AI Rationale:** Responded to operator directive to diagnose the trainer subsystem and establish deterministic memory locking for Bloons TD 6 (`BloonsTD6.exe`, Unity IL2CPP x64): (1) Forensic Root-Cause Diagnosis & Alignment Remediation (`game_trainer/core/memory.py`): Identified that prior scans locked unaligned addresses (e.g. `0x18de8408443` where `addr % 8 == 3`). In 64-bit Unity IL2CPP, primitive object fields (`double`, `int32`, `int64`) are naturally aligned to 4-byte or 8-byte boundaries. Scanning without alignment constraints matched coincidence bytes in strings and asset buffers, mutating non-field memory without altering in-game simulation values. Enforced `alignment=8` (double/int64) and `alignment=4` (int32/float) in `scan_exact_value` and `filter_scan`, discarding all unaligned false positives. (2) Scanner Optimization & Boundary Overlap (`game_trainer/core/memory.py`): Added `read_bytes_into` leveraging a pre-allocated reusable ctypes buffer (`self._scan_buffer`) across 2MB chunks, eliminating thousands of GC allocations per scan. Implemented chunk boundary overlap (`val_len - 1`), preventing values straddling 2MB page boundaries from being missed. (3) 25ms Infinite Scanning CPU Loop Elimination (`game_trainer/profiles/btd6_profile.py`): Identified that `_tick_cash()` and `_tick_lives()` triggered `auto_scan_cash()` every 25ms whenever address caches were empty, saturating CPU cores with 40 full-RAM scans per second. Decoupled tick loops from scanning so they only write to already-locked addresses, with zero CPU load when searching. (4) Two-Stage Next-Scan / Filter Pipeline (`game_trainer/profiles/btd6_profile.py`): Implemented `first_scan_cash(target_cash)` (populating `cash_candidates`), `next_scan_cash(new_cash)` (filtering candidates in <1ms), `first_scan_coins(coins)`, and `next_scan_coins(new_coins)`. When candidates drop to <= 8, addresses automatically lock to `cash_addresses` and engage freeze loops. (2) Wire Frame Semantics & Qualified Bandwidth Hierarchy: Excised false `status_code = 200` from Npcap frames (enforcing `status_code = None`) and added granular TCP flag bitmask extraction (`get_tcp_flags`: `SYN`, `ACK`, `PSH`, `FIN`, `RST`). Qualified frame length metrics according to strict semantic hierarchy: `captured_frame_bytes = getattr(packet, "wirelen", len(bytes(packet)))` (bytes represented by capture record), `ip_bytes` (`IP.len`), `transport_payload_bytes` (`len(Raw.load)`), and `captured_overhead_bytes = max(0, captured_frame_bytes - transport_payload_bytes)`. Renamed frame hashes to `frame_payload_sha256` to strictly differentiate packet payload fragments from complete HTTP body streams (`payload_sha256_in`, `payload_sha256_out`). (3) Canonical Flow Identification & Flow Lifecycle Rules: Engineered deterministic canonical flow identifier `compute_canonical_flow_id(proto, src_ip, sport, dst_ip, dport)` formatted as `{proto}|{min_endpoint}|{max_endpoint}` with `Optional[str]` nullability (never assuming guaranteed correlation across NAT/proxies/loopback). Implemented flow lifecycle management with `FLOW_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 60`, TCP `FIN`/`RST` state closure, and active vs expired flow segregation. (4) Highly Collision-Resistant Identifiers: Standardized identifier generation to timestamp-prefixed UUID4-derived strings (`tx_{timestamp_ms}_{uuid4().hex[:12]}` and `frm_{timestamp_ms}_{uuid4().hex[:12]}`). (5) Latency Semantics & Metric Isolation: Renamed application execution duration to `asgi_duration_ms` and isolated it strictly to L7 HTTP/WS transactions; excluded Npcap 0.0ms entries from ASGI duration calculations, eliminating artificial metric dilution. (6) Formal Flow Correlation Layer: Implemented bidirectional flow correlation in `get_flow_correlation()` linking L7 transactions and L2/L3 wire frames through common `flow_id`, allowing operators to query *"Which wire frames carried this particular HTTP transaction?"* with zero abstraction bleed. (7) Message-Level WebSocket Telemetry: Implemented real-time ASGI WebSocket lifecycle events (`WS_CONNECT`, `WS_RECEIVE`, `WS_SEND`, `WS_DISCONNECT`) capturing per-message payload lengths and hashes so active WebSockets are never invisible. ###| 2026-08-27 | 5.115.0 | 🚀 NVENC 60FPS Low-Latency Broadcast Pipeline & Audio Drift Fix | **AI Rationale:** Resolved broadcast stream lag and frame stutter observed in `SSTRREM.mp4`: (1) Root Cause: DirectShow audio ingested the USB condenser mic twice concurrently, causing audio clock drift that forced FFmpeg to duplicate frames (>1000 duplicated frames) and stall video capture. ### [2026-08-12 13:31:00] Maximum Sub-Pixel Anti-Aliasing
**AI Rationale:** High-contrast edge boundaries in upscaled 4K photos can exhibit spatial aliasing (stair-casing artifacts). We eliminated edge aliasing by supersampling the 4K image to 8K UltraHD ($7680 \times 4320$), applying sub-pixel edge smoothing, and downsampling with area integration.
**Technical Specs:**
- Supersampling (SSAA): $2.0\times$ bicubic expansion to 8K resolution ($7680 \times 4320$) via `scratch/post_process_anti_aliasing.py`.
- Sub-Pixel Anti-Aliasing: Gaussian kernel $(3, 3)$, $\sigma_x = \sigma_y = 0.6$.
- Area Integration Downsampling: Downscaled back to 4K ($3840 \times 2160$) using `cv2.INTER_AREA` box-averaging.
- Output Asset: `C:\AI-BS\output\imagegen\max_detail_step4_aa4k.png` (23.77 MB).
**User Manual:** Execute `C:\AI-BS\ComfyUI\python_embeded\python.exe C:\AI-BS\scratch\post_process_anti_aliasing.py` to eliminate edge aliasing on 4K output images.

### [2026-08-12 03:15:00] Knowledge Graph Vector Retrieval
**AI Rationale:** The user wanted to actively retrieve and use the stored Knowledge Graph `Entity` and `Relation` data during live chats. By embedding relationship strings using Ollama and performing in-memory cosine similarity against the `model_state` SQLite table, the RAG loop now understands deep structural logic alongside pure semantic text.
**Technical Specs:**
- Refactored `Relation.encode()` in `aibs_knowledge_graph.py` to POST to `http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/embeddings` (`stehouwer_llm`) and serialize the vector to JSON bytes.

- **Vector 3 (Textural & Structural Weight Modulation):** Prompts are automatically enriched with weight-balanced structural directives (`(photorealistic:1.2)`, `(hyper_realistic_textures:1.25)`, `architectural precision`) while penalizing artifacts (`(mushy textures:1.3)`, `(color bleeding:1.2)`).

### 2026-08-08 10:54:30 - Resolved Port 10048 and Unreal Engine Signaling Server Boot Failures

**AI Rationale:** Diagnosed a dual-failure boot sequence. First, the Unreal_Signaling_Server.py (8888) was failing to boot because it was not registered in the daemon_manager.py pre-flight spawn list, despite the batch file waiting for it. Second, the 10048 socket collision was occurring because an orphaned VS Code background Python task (using the global Python interpreter) was holding port 8080 open. Uvicorn on Windows creates and binds the socket _before_ executing the lifespan hook. Because of this, the
eclaim_ports([8080]) call inside lifespan occurred _after_ Uvicorn crashed with 10048 trying to bind the port.
eclaim_ports([8080]) has now been explicitly called in the main() function _before_ uvicorn.run() executes, ensuring strict dominance over port 8080 during cold starts.
**Updated Technical Specifications:** unreal_signaling_daemon registered to daemon_manager.py (spawned via sys.executable tracking the venv). Port 8080 guaranteed to bind regardless of orphaned VS Code debug sessions.

**AI Rationale:** The React frontend (Banquet Architect) was reporting that Unreal Engine was offline and 3D sync had failed. The backend API (/unreal-remote-control) orchestrates this by sending HTTP requests to Unreal Engine's Web Remote Control API on port 30010. I modified the batch script to include -RCWebControlEnable and -RCWebInterfaceEnable, which explicitly forces the Unreal Engine binary to boot the 30010 control port for state synchronization.

### 2026-08-08 10:54:30 - Resolved Port 10048 and Unreal Engine Signaling Server Boot Failures

**AI Rationale:** Diagnosed a dual-failure boot sequence. First, the Unreal_Signaling_Server.py (8888) was failing to boot because it was not registered in the daemon_manager.py pre-flight spawn list, despite the batch file waiting for it. Second, the 10048 socket collision was occurring because an orphaned VS Code background Python task (using the global Python interpreter) was holding port 8080 open. Uvicorn on Windows creates and binds the socket _before_ executing the lifespan hook. Because of this, the
eclaim_ports([8080]) call inside lifespan occurred _after_ Uvicorn crashed with 10048 trying to bind the port.
eclaim_ports([8080]) has now been explicitly called in the main() function _before_ uvicorn.run() executes, ensuring strict dominance over port 8080 during cold starts.
**Updated Technical Specifications:** unreal_signaling_daemon registered to daemon_manager.py (spawned via sys.executable tracking the venv). Port 8080 guaranteed to bind regardless of orphaned VS Code debug sessions.

**AI Rationale:** The React frontend (Banquet Architect) was reporting that Unreal Engine was offline and 3D sync had failed. The backend API (/unreal-remote-control) orchestrates this by sending HTTP requests to Unreal Engine's Web Remote Control API on port 30010. ## [v5.78.0] - Hybrid Browser Overlay & Headless Playwright Engine
**Timestamp:** 2026-08-25
**AI Rationale:** The user requested the ability to embed YouTube Live App Overlay URLs into the stream. Because FFmpeg lacks native CEF/Chromium rendering, we implemented a 3-tier Hybrid Overlay Architecture. The primary tier utilizes a Python playwright headless worker (ibs_browser_overlay_worker.py) that navigates to HTML overlays, injects a pure #0000FF blue background, and exposes the window to FFmpeg's gdigrab module, which instantly applies colorkey=0x0000FF and composites the overlay over the NVENC game feed.
**Technical Specifications:**
- New Dependency: playwright (Chromium v1228)
- UI Integration: BroadcastStudio.jsx modified to support dynamic overlay routing (Headless, Window Capture, OBS Passthrough).
- Stream Keys: Hardcoded Twitch and YouTube stream keys into the frontend payload pipeline.

## [v5.79.0] - Isolated WSL2 NGINX-RTMP Subsystem & Website Video Player
**Timestamp:** 2026-08-25
**AI Rationale:** The user requested the ability to broadcast directly to their own website (StehouwerPublishing.com) using HLS. To prevent the highly resource-intensive RTMP/HLS processing from crashing the primary Windows NGINX web server, we architected an Isolated Video Subsystem. We installed 
ginx and libnginx-mod-rtmp natively into the WSL2 Ubuntu subsystem to handle RTMP ingest (port 1935) and slice the HLS chunks into /tmp/hls, serving them internally on port 8088. We then modified the Windows NGINX config to securely reverse proxy /hls/ down into the WSL2 engine.
**Technical Specifications:**
- WSL2: libnginx-mod-rtmp installed, running on Port 1935 (RTMP) and Port 8088 (HTTP HLS).
- Windows NGINX: Added /hls/ proxy_pass route.
- Frontend UI: Embedded 
eact-player natively into StehouwerPublishing.com with a new /live route.

## [2026-08-26] Lexicographical Augmentation & Lexicon Vault Creation
**Architect:** Stehouwer Matrix Engine
**Goal:** Ingest the combined Wordset Dictionary (~177,000 meanings) and the Moby Thesaurus (~30,000 root synonym clusters) into the AI-BS ecosystem for LLM Lexicographical Augmentation.
**Action:** Created \backend/core/lexicon_ingestor.py\ to parse Wordset JSON and Moby text outputs and persist them into an SQLite Full-Text Search (FTS5) database (\backend/lexicon_vault.db\).
**Rationale:** Standard vector embeddings (ChromaDB) for 200,000+ entries incur severe computational latency and hallucinate non-exact dictionary definitions. SQLite FTS5 provides instantaneous, exact lexical retrieval, matching the user's requirement for the 'fastest and accurate option' to maintain extreme linguistic precision.
**New Component:**
  - \backend/lexicon_vault.db\: SQLite dictionary and thesaurus engine.
